title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 859 North State Road 21 in Melrose, Florida, as the "Pamela Jane Rock Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 859 North State Road 21 in Melrose, Florida, as the Pamela Jane Rock Post Office Building.

summary.headline: A federal law renames a Melrose, Florida post office building after Pamela Jane Rock.
summary.what_it_does: This law gives a new name to the U.S. Postal Service facility at 859 North State Road 21 in Melrose, Florida. The building will be called the Pamela Jane Rock Post Office Building. It does not change postal services, rules, or costs.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on May 7, 2024.
